    """Ground truth = accuracy of dosage-0 models (uncontaminated).

    For dosage-0 models, raw accuracy IS the clean accuracy.
    For dosage>0 models, we use the mean d=0 accuracy as the
    counterfactual reference (what they would score without contamination).

    d0_mask = dosages == 0

    ground_truth[d0_mask] = raw_acc[d0_mask]
